creator: Alexander Terp
description: MIP-4 Delivery stage 1. `muster-msg` with the default policy; the `msg.*` requests; participants, groups, the log and its persistence, the cursor and the unread guard; `join`, `leave`, `who`, `post`, `read`, `log`, `wait`; the inbox-socket adapter; the Linux build of `muster-cli`. Opens with the Claude observation (MIP-4, "What is not yet verified"), since it decides whether a bypass session needs `crossSessionInbound` or the hooks adapter. Proves: two Claude sessions in plain terminals, on the Mac and on the devenv, exchange messages with nothing polling; the guard refuses a post on unread; a log survives a daemon restart.
title: MIP-4 stage 1: one machine, two agents, no panes
